superseded_finding: The previous run of this receipt recorded openai-python failing parallel_tool_calls against Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-Q4_K_M. That was NOT a merc defect and NOT an SDK defect: llama.cpp returned 'Failed to parse input at pos 47' for that model's tool template, reproducible by calling the engine directly. Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct parses the same schema and both clients pass.
model_caveat: Tool-calling support is a property of the MODEL and its llama.cpp chat template, not of merc's surface. Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-Q4_K_M cannot serve parallel tool calls on llama.cpp. Any catalogue entry advertising tools must be conformance-checked on the model that will actually serve them.
